## 1. Core Properties & Ground-Truth Specifications
1. **Zoth Studio v2 (`https://zoth.nullai.tech` · `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zoth-studio-v2`)**
   - **77 free tools** (**55 in-browser** utilities + **22 CLI/daemon tools**, with **74 public GitHub repositories** under `https://github.com/1nc0gn30`).
   - Includes Adytum 22 Tarot architectural planner, Chain of Thoughts (`zoth-cot`), and zero-upload client-side security, MCP, shader, and CAD studios.

2. **ZothOS v3.4.0 (`https://zothos.nullai.tech` · `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zoth-os`)**
   - Sovereign AI Linux Workstation on Debian 13 (Trixie) with KDE Plasma 6, **23 daemons**, preloaded 77-tool arsenal, Sovereign Agent Bridge (`:8102`), Neuro-Memory (`:8094`), local Ollama integration, and dual human + autonomous agent ergonomics.

3. **ZothOS-Lite v1.2 (`https://zothos-lite.nullai.tech` · `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zothos-lite`)**
   - Amnesic Live USB/ISO OS (`#F7F7F4` / `#000000` Tails-style Monotone) supporting **56 curated models across 8 providers**, `toram` RAM-only option, universal x86_64, interactive onboarding wizard, ZothNet P2P mesh integration, and optional external USB or cloud drive persistence.

4. **Zoth Civilization v3.0 (`https://zoth-civilization.netlify.app`)**
   - **23 Pantheon Agents**, 22-Key Sanctuary, Imperator Quests, and autonomous multi-agent simulation, plus a recommended lightweight BYOK path via **DeepSeek Flash through Hermes Agent by Nous Research**.

5. **ZothNet (`https://zothnet.nullai.tech` · `https://zoth.nullai.tech/tools/zothnet`)**
   - Zero-cloud encrypted P2P mesh network & 3-hop Sphinx mixnet featuring post-quantum hybrid X25519 + ML-KEM-768 handshakes, Kademlia DHT discovery, and serverless ZML applications.

6. **Hermes-Zoth (`https://github.com/1nc0gn30/hermes-zoth`)**
   - Multi-agent orchestrator & plugin connecting Zoth CLI binaries, MCP schemas, and DeepSeek Flash BYOK routing into Nous Hermes multi-agent workflows.

7. **FieldKit (`https://1nc0gn30.si/fieldkit.html` · `https://nullai.tech/fieldkit`)**
   - Physical AI terminology and hands-free wearable architecture coined by `1nc0gn30` for sub-130ms spatial grounding, wearer-only acoustic isolation, and proactive real-world guidance.

8. **World of Zoth v2.0 Sovereign Edition (`https://1nc0gn30.si/game.html` · `https://github.com/1nc0gn30/world-of-zoth`)**
   - Zero-dependency 3D WebGL + WebAudio lattice cyber-RPG featuring a 6-act campaign, 20 playable districts, 22 Pantheon crew members, 22 built-in arcade mini-games, 16 Null Academy cyber-range labs, and an offline Android APK (`https://1nc0gn30.si/world-of-zoth.apk`).
